name: lotestigo
description: Despliegue de LoTestigo: frontend en Cloudflare Workers y backend en Railway

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('data/evidence', 'frontend/dist/frontend/browser/media/evidence', { recursive: true, filter: (path) => !path.endsWith('.gitkeep') })"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.155.0 deploy
